digest.component_or_area: LLM runner and structured output framework
propositions: Consolidate all mode="structured" consumers onto a single one-operation Pydantic bounded-Agent path through the PydanticAIRunner facade, eliminating bespoke fresh-Agent output-attempt loops and manual retry machinery.

Retain structured_retry_limit as the output-retry-allowance cap; seed both Agent retries={"output":N} and UsageLimits addend from N=min(OUTPUT_RETRIES, max(0, structured_retry_limit)), ensuring structured_retry_limit=0 yields zero output-repair retries (single-shot fail-safe).
Ensure well-formed first responses perform exactly one outer model run (agent.run_sync); only the bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade triggers a second run; never a third.

Verify all existing provider fallback eligibility, tool limits, timeout/transport ownership, provenance, serialized output shapes, and candidate tracing remain unchanged across plan-review, code-review, overlap, and evaluation consumers.
